name: urbanlens-integration-tests
description: On-demand integration tests for a deployed UrbanLens instance.

scripts._comment:location: Needs UL_E2E_LOCATION_DATA=1 in the environment (bin/run_integration_tests.sh --project location sets it), and an account provisioned with --external-apis.
scripts._comment:visual: Needs UL_E2E_VISUAL=1 in the environment - the project is not registered without it. Set as a variable rather than inline here, because an inline VAR=value prefix is not portable to Windows shells.
scripts._comment:crossbrowser: Needs UL_E2E_CROSS_BROWSER=1 in the environment, for the same reason.
